caption:
MYTH BUSTED 🚨

Checking your OWN credit score does not lower it.
It's called a soft inquiry, and it has zero impact on your score.

The ones that can hurt? Hard inquiries, when a lender checks because you applied for credit.

Did you believe this one? 👇
first_comment: Be honest: did you think checking your score hurt it? Tell us below 👇
